beats.title: Opening fight with the guards begins under ominous runes
beats.summary: The session opens in a combat scene where the party engages guards and the first spell triggers a dangerous environmental response. A surprise round starts, Thunderwave damages a group of guards, a chandelier falls, and glowing runes appear on the walls.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-12:26abfa1c2dba:span:26abfa1c2dba:36-36
anchor_quotes: The attack by Bonogo on the Wolf sets up a surprise round.
Caelynn is first to attack, casting Thunderwave on one of the groups of 8 guards.
Runes begin to glow all along the walls around the room.

evidence_refs.label: full-corpus:longmont-c1:session-12:26abfa1c2dba:span:26abfa1c2dba:38-38
anchor_quotes: The Wolf, sensing danger, downs an Invisibility Potion and disappears.
Kasrsemine quickly uses Hunter’s Mark and deals a major blow to a guard.

beats.title: Runes are revealed as Council-linked anti-spell defenses
beats.summary: The party learns the runes are a protection against spells for the Council and that they target anyone not wearing an amulet. This reframes the fight as a magical defense mechanism tied to the Council.

anchor_quotes: the Runes are a protection against spells for the Council.
They are set to target anyone not wearing an amulet.

beats.title: Rune attacks escalate and the party suffers heavy losses
beats.summary: The runes cycle into force and paralysis effects, knocking characters out of the fight. Caelynn is paralyzed, Thalia is turned against the group, and Stafl is blasted upward and rendered unconscious.
